typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		reportingEntity as string,
		{Interface ID} as string,
		{Interface Name} as string,
		Source as string,
		Target as string,
		Frequency as string,
		{Sent/Received} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Date/Time Sent/Received} as string,
		{Process Start Time} as string,
		{Process End Time} as string,
		{File Size} as long,
		{Records Sent/Received} as long,
		{Records Processed (Target Only)} as string,
		{Error Count (Target Only)} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @NC_Extract_Config TABLE (Extract_Config_Code VARCHAR(10),Interface_Id VARCHAR(100),Interface_Name VARCHAR(100)) INSERT INTO @NC_Extract_Config (Extract_Config_Code,Interface_Id,Interface_Name) VALUES  (\'MED_P_T\',\'PLA-I-0222-001\',\'Professional MC Encounters from PHP - BCBSNC\'), (\'MED_I_T\',\'PLA-I-0223-001\',\'PHP to CCNC TOC Institutional Encounters\'), (\'NCPDP_T\',\'PLA-I-0224-001\',\'PHP to CCNC TOC NCPDP Encounters\'), (\'MED_P_L\',\'PLA-I-0250-001\',\'PHP - BCBSNC to CCNC CMARC/CMHRP Professional Claims and Encounters\'), (\'MED_I_L\',\'PLA-I-0301-001\',\'PHP-BCBSNC to CCNC CMARC/CMHRP Institutional Claims and Encounters\'), (\'DEN_L\',\'PLA-I-0332-001\',\'PHP-BCBSNC to CCNC CMARC/CMHRP Dental Claims\'), (\'NCPDP_L\',\'PLA-I-0444-001\',\'PHP-BCBSNC to CCNC CMARC/CMHRP NCPDP Claims and Encounters\')  SELECT DISTINCT	\'PHP - BCBSNC\' AS reportingEntity,  		EC.Interface_Id AS [Interface ID], 		EC.Interface_Name AS [Interface Name],  		\'PHP - BCBSNC\' AS [Source], 		\'CCNC\' AS [Target], 		CASE WHEN EC.Extract_Config_Code LIKE \'%L\' THEN \'Weekly\' ELSE \'Daily\' END AS [Frequency], 		\'Sending Entity\' AS [Sent/Received], 		\'Success\' AS [Status],   		 FORMAT(H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME,\'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm tt\')  AS [Date/Time Sent/Received], 		 FORMAT(H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_EXECUTION_TIME,\'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm tt\')  AS [Process Start Time], 		 FORMAT(H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME,\'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm tt\') AS [Process End Time], 		F.[Extract_History_File_Size] AS [File Size], 	 		F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILE_RECORDCOUNT AS [Records Sent/Received], 		\'(partner leaves blank)\' AS [Records Processed (Target Only)], 		\'(partner leaves blank)\' AS [Error Count (Target Only)]   	FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.NC_AMH_EXTRACT_HISTORY_TMP H	 	INNER JOIN DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.NC_AMH_EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILES_TMP F ON H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_IID = F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_IID 	     		AND H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME BETWEEN ? AND ? 		AND H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME IS NOT NULL 		AND H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE IN (?) 		AND F.Extract_History_File_Recipient IN (?) 		AND (Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_MEDENCCLMPHD%\' 		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_MEDENCCLMIHD%\' 		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_RXENCHD%\' 		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_DENCLMHD%\') 	  	INNER JOIN @NC_Extract_Config EC ON  EC.[Extract_Config_Code] = H.[Extract_Config_Code]  ORDER BY  [Date/Time Sent/Received],EC.Interface_Name',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DataExchangeLogTables
DataExchangeLogTables derive({Copy of reportingEntity} = toString(reportingEntity),
		{Copy of Status} = toString(Status),
		{Copy of Target} = toString(Target),
		{Copy of Frequency} = toString(Frequency),
		{Copy of Sent/Received} = toString({Sent/Received}),
		{Copy of Source} = toString(Source)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MonitoringReport
